summary:
Newegg is the computer-parts retailer at newegg.com. Builders look up its favicon when a cart or a price-watch bookmark shows a blank tab.

Checked 12 November 2026 against newegg.com. HTML came from https://www.newegg.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.newegg.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 4286 bytes. Directory sizes: 32×32.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.newegg.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 152×152 png.

Brand colour #003366 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-152x152-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-152x152-01.png at 152×152 (png, 8542 bytes) from https://www.newegg.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
